newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Morgan Stanley says sells ABB at 111 SKR. [corrected 10:07 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Morgan Stanley says sells ABB at 111 SKR. [corrected 10:07 GMT]

text.p: Investment bank Morgan Stanley Dean Witter said on Thursday its offer price to institutional investors for shares in Sweden's ABB AB was 111 crowns, a three percent discount on the share's June 11 closing price.

Swedish investment and medical technology group Incentive said on Wednesday it had sold half its stake in ABB AB for 12.4 billion crowns, of which 6.5 billion crowns worth was sold to Swedish investment group Investor.
The other six billion crowns worth of shares were sold to Morgan Stanley Dean Witter to sell to institutional investors.

Investor, however, paid 114.5 crowns per share, or the June 11 closing price, said a Morgan Stanley spokesman. (corrects source) "The general view is that there was only one price. This market misconception is causing some anxiety," he told Reuters.
